payload.progress: V3 now states the correct write-ahead ordering and continuous serialization intent. Keep that design; clarify only the remaining contradictions below.
acceptance_clarifications: Specify exact client access/open masks, not GENERIC_WRITE: the named-pipe generic write mapping includes FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE. Separate ordinary client rights from any owner creation rights and document the same-account trust limit. Microsoft recommends individual rights.

GetNamedPipeInfo does not report PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS; its documented flags describe endpoint/type. Verify the creation flag at the API boundary and specify a valid later remote-rejection test under separate activation approval. Do not claim that API proves an unreported flag.

Reuse the actual Coordinator.gate dispatch RLock. The route-owner adapter also has a distinct registration mutex; that is not the effect/lease/reconciliation gate. All relevant transitions must share the existing coordinator gate.

A lock does not stop time or make an external effect atomic. Validate approval/lease eligibility at the final pre-dispatch boundary; expiry or revocation after entry cannot promise rollback, whole completion before expiry, or no partial effect. Preserve uncertainty and prohibit a new start when authorization has expired.

Intent write/fsync failure means no backend dispatch, but may leave partial journal bytes. Outcome persistence failure means effect status is uncertain, not definitely applied. Fail closed on unresolved or damaged evidence; do not assume a clean absent record.

Independent quiescence evidence does not authorize replay or prove the original effect did not occur. Reconciliation records supported outcomes and retains consumed allowances; repeating an operation requires separately valid authority and evidence under the existing contract, never automatic replay.
payload.request: Return a short delta against these finite acceptance points, not a new architecture. Existing fake-backend cases should assert zero expired starts, durable uncertainty without duplicate effects, safe partial-journal handling and correct gate use. These are design-review clarifications; no new implementation has been executed or found defective.
payload.limits: No implementation approval, listener/ACL changes, credentials, backend activation or live GUI input. Keep private source and identifiers private.
